description: **object** Video & Audio Muxer which generates directly downloadable links from a Youtube video. Billing per call: 10 Credits.

audioFormat.description:
**string**
Sets the audio format for downloads (e.g., mp3, ogg, wav). Default: mp3
Throws:
Error if the provided format is not valid.
audioFormat.title: audioFormat

codec.description:
**string**
Sets the video codec for downloads. The desired video codec (e.g., h264, vp9, av1). H264 codec is set by default.
Throws:
Error if the provided codec is not valid.
codec.title: codec

endTime.description:
**datetime or unsigned integer**
Trims video or audio with reference to end time. Time in [HH:mm:ss](https://www.w3.org/TR/NOTE-datetime) format or in milliseconds.
endTime.title: endTime

id.description: Youtube video ID in expected format `(/^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{11}$/)`
id.title: id

language.description:
**string**
specifies the language of audio to download when a youtube video is dubbed. 
E.g.: en / ru / cs / ja / es-US / ...
language.title: language

quality.description:
**string**
Sets the video quality for downloads. The desired video quality (e.g. 144, 240, 360, 480, 720, 1080, 1440, 2160, 4320, max). 720 quality is recommended for phones.
Throws:
Error if the provided quality is not valid.
quality.title: quality

startTime.description:
**datetime or unsigned integer**
Trims video or audio with reference to start time. Time in [HH:mm:ss](https://www.w3.org/TR/NOTE-datetime) format or in milliseconds.
startTime.title: startTime

watermark.description:
**array** 
Adds an image to the video. List of values:
1. *URL
2. position: topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomRight, center (default) or pixel coordinates in x:y format from top left corner.
3. Scale (%widest side)
4. Transparency between 0 and 1 (none)
watermark.title: watermark

name: get_mux
title: Video/audio streams muxer
